name: Melzo — YT Music Stream
author: Prashant
description: Plays and downloads matching tracks from YouTube Music. A Melzo build of the YouTube Music source by solidsnakeater, itself based on the project by y-exe.
changelog: 1.0.0: Melzo build. Same matching and playback engine as the original (GPL-3.0); new id, name and author, and the app-version gate lowered so it installs on 1.0.x.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Plays the matching track from YouTube Music

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Finds the official song on YouTube Music to download

actions.name: network
actions.why: Searches songs, gets audio URLs, checks them
